decision_gate_review.alternative_selection: Development-only first passing .48 then .46; signed/hash-bound record before any heldout execution, diagnostics or opportunity computation; unselected success sensitivity-only.
decision_gate_review.exact_and_security: Every individual authoritative target rank is guarded, not merely best-target summaries. Newly introduced registered wrong IDs and any unauthorized exposure cannot be offset by semantic gains. Missing correctness evidence is not a pass.
decision_gate_review.opportunity: Fixed72 useful pairs per seed, native unboosted branch scores and fixed bands; score opportunity never creates labels or permits rerolls. Any insufficient seed means D for general A/B/C claims.
decision_gate_review.latency: One warmup plus10 measured repetitions; only groups with at least100 samples are guard-eligible. Smaller subgroups may report descriptive interpolation with guard_eligible:false; no pooled rescue or repetition inflation.
decision_gate_review.legacy: Resolved legacy comparisons are explicitly diagnostic guard evidence with unknown coverage disclosed; they do not replace complete supplementary truth.
